attributes.description: TTK Healthcare Ltd is a standalone TTK Group company in consumer /OTC brands, animal health, medical devices, condoms/sexual-wellness and ready-to-fry foods. Human Pharma was divested in May 2022; agreements to sell EVA and Good Home were signed in July 2026.[1][2]
